name: Calendar Pomodoro
author: u2b22
description: Pomodoro countdown driven by one Google calendar: the bar counts down the block in progress, a click lists today's blocks, and a 5 or 15 minute gap between blocks shows a full-screen break screen.

barWidget.description: Counts down the current block on the selected calendar

schema.label: Calendar name
schema.description: Display name of the Google calendar whose timed events are the pomodoros.

schema.label: Skip phrase
schema.description: Typing this phrase is the only way to leave a break early. Case and spaces are ignored.
